items.text: Texans complete trade with Cardinals for WR Marvin Harrison Jr. (MHJ + 7th for 2nd + 6th); inactive for ARI, joins HOU.
items.why: Blockbuster confirmed by Schefter/Rap; Ryans announced postgame.
items.implication: MHJ ROS boost with Stroud reunion; ARI WR room opens, HOU depth improves behind Collins.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson/others more targets in ARI; MHJ long-term upside in HOU.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery downgraded to out with groin injury.
items.why: Groin; Rap had Q earlier then out.
items.implication: Sit Montgomery; HOU RB committee shifts.

items.text: FINAL UPDATE: Ashton Jeanty will play, Terry McLaurin will play; projections live.
items.why: Jeanty pregame workout ok after plantar/ankle; McLaurin cleared. Rap confirms Jeanty go.
items.implication: Start both; monitor Jeanty workload for limitations.
items.opportunity: Jeanty carries/role as lead RB if full; McLaurin WR usage.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins will play vs Dolphins after questionable tags; projections updated.
items.why: Cleared concussion/protocol and full practices; Schefter corroborates both will play.
items.implication: Start both as usual in strong matchup; no snap limits confirmed pregame.
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets expected for CIN WR1/WR2.

items.text: Justin Jefferson expected to play, Jordan Addison not expected; final updates confirm Jefferson active/Addison inactive.
items.why: Jefferson ankle cleared for home game in LA; Addison hamstring keeps him out. Rap/Schefter confirm.
items.implication: Start Jefferson confidently; Addison sits, boosting Jefferson target share.

items.text: 49ers WR Deebo Samuel Sr. out remainder of game due to hamstring.
items.why: Hamstring mid-game; Rap confirms ruled out.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 6; SF WR targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/routes for other SF WRs.

items.text: Coaching staffs refuse workhorse on Jaylen Warren despite elite advanced stats/eye test (Ekeler-esque); was splitting with Rico Dowdle pre-injury.
items.why: Dowdle out/not expected; Warren passes all tests.
items.implication: Warren strong start/ROS with Dowdle sidelined.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps/routes for Warren as lead back.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey active but not expected to play meaningful snaps.
items.implication: Avoid in fantasy; targets elsewhere in LAC.
items.opportunity: Boost to Quentin Johnston/Tre Harris etc if out fully.

items.text: Vikings TE T.J. Hockenson (concussion) downgraded to out.
items.implication: MIN TE streamer opportunity; Jefferson more targets possible.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams officially inactive but has chance to play next week.
items.implication: Sit; Bears backup QB starts, impacts CHI pass catchers.

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs best salary-adjusted value; only 61.5% owned in DK single-entry double-ups despite elite projection. Cash review highlights.
items.why: Top projection value even at high salary; low ownership for chalk.
items.implication: Strong cash/GPP play; broader NFL usage elite.
items.opportunity: High snap/target/carry share in DET offense.

items.text: Holy hell what a TD catch by Trey McBride.
items.why: Highlight reel TD reinforces elite TE usage.
items.implication: Continue starting as TE1; strong ROS.

items.text: Zay Flowers officially active for Ravens vs Falcons.
Marshawn Lloyd killing it on waiver wires everywhere.
items.why: Postgame heat after performance; add candidate.
items.implication: Priority waiver add for GB RB depth/handcuff upside.
items.opportunity: Potential role expansion if Jacobs limited.
